# Explicitly authorised edits to never-touch pages.
#
# Format: <path> <sha256 of the file content as authorised>
#
# The deny list exists to stop UNAUTHORISED edits. An edit Connor asked for is not
# one. But "Connor said it was fine" is not a mechanism, so the authorisation is
# pinned to the exact file content: if services.html changes again by so much as a
# byte, the hash stops matching and check-deny-list.sh fails as it should.
#
# services.html, authorised 2026-09-09. Connor authorised removing one project card
# left broken by the Panther National removal. Verified before writing: the removed
# block contained no Buy American, TAA or BABA text, the
# taa-baba-buy-american-act-glazing.html link diffed byte-identical, and anchor tags
# balance 88 to 88. See decisions.md.
#
# services.html, authorised 2026-09-24. Connor's blanket SEO approval. One href on
# the Ocean Prime card now points at the indexable keeper. Buy American, TAA, and
# BABA text was not in that line. The diff is that href only.
